faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Nuapada District Court Group-D (Daily Wage) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the offline application form for the Nuapada District Court Group-D (Daily Wage) recruitment is 03-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum age requirement for the Group-D posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for the Group-D (Daily Wage) posts is 18 years.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Group-D posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Group-D (Daily Wage) posts is 42 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class VIII (M.E. Standard) to be eligible for the Group-D (Daily Wage) posts.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for Group-D posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies available for Group-D (Daily Wage) posts in Nuapada District Court.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Group-D posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Group-D (Daily Wage) posts is Rs. 472 Per Day.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the Nuapada District Court Group-D recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Group-D posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Group-D (Daily Wage) posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Nuapada District Court, and links are provided in the Important Links section of this article.
